description: Kernel timeout management implementation for Zephyr RTOS, including timeout scheduling, cancellation, and clock announcement handling.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first timeout in the list.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next timeout after a given timeout.

methods.name: remove_timeout
methods.description: Removes a timeout from the list and adjusts subsequent timeout.

methods.name: elapsed
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time considering current execution context.

methods.name: next_timeout
methods.description: Determines the next timeout duration.

methods.name: z_add_timeout
methods.description: Adds a new timeout to the list with specified callback and duration.

methods.name: z_abort_timeout
methods.description: Aborts a scheduled timeout.

methods.name: timeout_rem
methods.description: Calculates remaining ticks for a timeout.

methods.name: z_timeout_remaining
methods.description: Returns remaining ticks for a timeout.

methods.name: z_timeout_expires
methods.description: Returns the absolute tick count when a timeout expires.

methods.name: z_get_next_timeout_expiry
methods.description: Returns the next timeout expiry duration.

methods.name: sys_clock_announce
methods.description: Announces passage of ticks and triggers due timeouts.

methods.name: sys_clock_tick_get
methods.description: Returns current tick count.

methods.name: sys_clock_tick_get_32
methods.description: Returns current tick count as 32-bit value.

methods.name: z_impl_k_uptime_ticks
methods.description: Returns uptime in ticks.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_uptime_ticks
methods.description: Verification function for uptime ticks.

methods.name: sys_timepoint_calc
methods.description: Calculates a timepoint based on a timeout.

methods.name: sys_timepoint_timeout
methods.description: Converts a timepoint to a timeout.

methods.name: z_impl_sys_clock_tick_set
methods.description: Sets the current tick for testing.

methods.name: z_vrfy_sys_clock_tick_set
methods.description: Verification function for setting tick.
